results.title: EchoStar to put Hughes Network into bankruptcy
results.description: Charlie Ergen, co-founder of EchoStar, has reportedly decided to place its wholly-owned subsidiary Hughes Network Systems into Chapter 11 bankruptcy. results.title: Inflation Outlook Raised As Higher June PPI Suggests Mounting Cost Pressure
results.description: Malaysia’s business inflation in June accelerated to the fastest pace in four years amid higher energy costs, official data released on Tuesday showed. Producer Price Index (PPI) accelerated to +9.2%yoy in Jun-26 (from +7.8%yoy in May-26); marking its fourth consecutive month of growth and the sharpest annual surge since Jun-22.
